summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing management's participation in the KBW Summer Bank Conference in New York City on July 28-29, 2026. The filing is purely an investor-relations announcement with no special-situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital return. The press release describes one-on-one meetings to discuss business momentum and opportunities, but contains no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics. There is no deal to analyze; the filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer.
